summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed its Q2 2026 production results via Form 6-K on July 9, 2026. Within the press release, the Company disclosed a proposed business combination with Orla Mining, positioning Equinox as the acquirer in a merger creating a premier North American gold producer. Terms such as price per share, premium, or implied value are not stated. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The deal is expected to produce ~1.1M oz gold annually in 2026 with a pathway to ~1.9M oz. What to watch: regulatory and shareholder approvals; risk-arb hinges on closing timeline and any competing bids.
